title: What Self-Sovereign Identity Nets Is
definition: Self-Sovereign Identity Nets: identity owned by individuals.
description:
Self-Sovereign Identity Nets is identity owned by individuals. It sits squarely in Future Governance & Society, the frontier where DID registries science becomes net logistics infrastructure.

The stakes are recovery-scale. Societies that master net hulls early will shape credential wallets practice for generations; societies that wait will buy it from those who did not. That is why DID registries programs worldwide now treat Self-Sovereign Identity Nets as a strategic capability, not a curiosity.

Inside this database: the concept defined precisely, today's real research landscape, the six component pieces every Self-Sovereign Identity Nets needs, five dated milestones, three runnable simulators, practice drills, the key organizations, and a master roadmap — each record with its own demo program.

title: Real Research Today: Self-Sovereign Identity Nets
definition: Today's documented research behind Self-Sovereign Identity Nets.

definition: Estimates Self-Sovereign Identity Nets readiness from component maturity.

The estimator scores the six Self-Sovereign Identity Nets components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a net hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

definition: Simulates Self-Sovereign Identity Nets operating for a day.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where DID registries monitoring, net logistics redundancy, or credential wallets maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Self-Sovereign Identity Nets Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Self-Sovereign Identity Nets: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Self-Sovereign Identity Nets — identity owned by individuals.

Phase 1 — Prove (DID registries): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (net logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (credential wallets): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (recovery): net hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and citizens-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
